construction.implementation_origin: New, independently written reference implementation using synthetic fixtures

input.fixture_label: nonblank label; provided fixture explicitly SYNTHETIC
input.steps: ordered array of {id, title, prerequisites: unique step ID array, required_fields: unique field name array}
input.actions: ordered array of {step_id, operation: start|complete, answers?: object}

output.success: {schema_version, status: ok, fixture_label, steps, events, progress, next_steps}
output.error: {schema_version, status: error, error: {code: invalid_input, message}}; exit 2

shared_schema.validation: One Validator shared by request, step definitions and actions. Unknown fields, missing fields, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite JSON literals, invalid types, unknown IDs, duplicate IDs and cyclic prerequisites are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated request and acyclic prerequisite index feed deterministic action replay.
Replay state and submitted answers feed ordered step statuses, progress and next-step guidance.

behavior.transitions: pending -> in_progress via start; in_progress -> completed via complete. All prerequisites must be completed. Repeated operations are errors.
behavior.answers: Completion requires exactly the declared required_fields, each with a nonblank string value. Start accepts no answers.
behavior.progress: Completed/total percentage rounded to two decimals, counts per state, finished flag; empty plan is finished at 100%.
behavior.guidance: Blocked prerequisite IDs, required fields, start eligibility, and ordered available or active next_steps.
behavior.determinism: No clock, randomness, external I/O beyond reading the selected CLI input. Input is never mutated; output ordering follows definitions and actions.
behavior.atomicity: An invalid action rejects the entire request; no partial result or persisted side effects.
behavior.persistence: Caller retains request/action history or JSON output. Replaying history reconstructs progress.
behavior.parallel_readiness: Independent steps may be in progress simultaneously.

excluded: Real identity, shipping or business verification

test_outcomes.cli: passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status ok, 33.33% complete
test_outcomes.error_cli: verified exit 2 and JSON error for missing file, invalid arguments, malformed JSON, invalid schema, duplicate keys, nonfinite literals and Unicode read failure
